This documentation explains how to use the `paper_project.html` layout, which is based on the [Academic Project Page Template](https://github.com/eliahuhorwitz/Academic-project-page-template) but adapted for Jekyll.

## Overview

The `paper_project.html` layout provides a comprehensive template for academic paper project pages with the following features:

- Hero section with title, authors, and links
- Teaser video section
- Abstract section
- Image carousel
- YouTube video embedding
- Video carousel
- Poster display
- BibTeX citation
- Custom content sections

## Usage

Create a markdown file with the layout specified in the front matter:

```yaml
---
layout: paper_project
title: "Your Paper Title"
# ... other front matter variables
---

Your additional markdown content here...
```

## Front Matter Variables

### Required Variables

- `layout: paper_project` - Specifies the layout to use
- `title` - The main title of your paper/project

### Optional Variables

#### Authors Section
```yaml
authors:
  - name: "Author Name"
    url: "https://author-website.com"  # optional
    equal_contrib: true  # optional, adds * symbol
```

#### Affiliations
```yaml
affiliations:
  - name: "Institution Name"
    conference: "Conference Name 2024"  # optional

equal_contrib_note: "Indicates Equal Contribution"  # optional
```

#### Links Section
```yaml
links:
  - name: "Paper"
    url: "https://arxiv.org/pdf/XXXX.XXXX.pdf"
    icon: "fas fa-file-pdf"
  - name: "Code"
    url: "https://github.com/your-repo"
    icon: "fab fa-github"
  - name: "arXiv"
    url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/XXXX.XXXX"
    icon: "ai ai-arxiv"
```

#### Teaser Video
```yaml
teaser_video:
  url: "/assets/video/teaser.mp4"
  poster: "/assets/img/poster.jpg"  # optional
  autoplay: true  # optional
  controls: true  # optional
  muted: true     # optional
  loop: true      # optional
  caption: "Video description"  # optional
```

#### Abstract
```yaml
abstract: "Your paper abstract text here..."
```

#### Image Carousel
```yaml
image_carousel:
  title: "Results Gallery"  # optional
  images:
    - url: "/assets/img/result1.jpg"
      alt: "Alt text"  # optional
      caption: "Image description"  # optional
    - url: "/assets/img/result2.jpg"
      caption: "Another description"
```

#### YouTube Video
```yaml
youtube_video:
  title: "Video Presentation"  # optional, defaults to "Video Presentation"
  url: "https://www.youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID"
```

#### Video Carousel
```yaml
video_carousel:
  title: "Demonstrations"  # optional, defaults to "Video Carousel"
  videos:
    - url: "/assets/video/demo1.mp4"
      poster: "/assets/img/poster1.jpg"  # optional
      autoplay: true  # optional
      controls: true  # optional
      muted: true     # optional
      loop: true      # optional
      caption: "Demo description"  # optional
```

#### Poster
```yaml
poster:
  title: "Poster"  # optional, defaults to "Poster"
  url: "/assets/pdf/poster.pdf"
  height: "600"  # optional, defaults to "550"
```

#### BibTeX Citation
```yaml
bibtex: |
  @article{yourname2024paper,
    title={Your Paper Title},
    author={Author One and Author Two},
    journal={Conference/Journal Name},
    year={2024}
  }
```

#### Acknowledgments
```yaml
acknowledgments: "Your acknowledgments text here..."
```

#### External Dependencies
```yaml
include_bulma_css: true    # Include Bulma CSS framework
include_carousel_js: true  # Include carousel JavaScript
```

#### Custom Styles
```yaml
_styles: |
  .custom-class {
    background-color: #f0f0f0;
    padding: 1rem;
  }
```

## Asset Organization

### Recommended Directory Structure
```
assets/
├── img/
│   ├── teaser_poster.jpg
│   ├── result1.jpg
│   ├── result2.jpg
│   └── demo_posters/
├── video/
│   ├── teaser.mp4
│   ├── demo1.mp4
│   └── demo2.mp4
└── pdf/
    ├── paper.pdf
    ├── supplementary.pdf
    └── poster.pdf
```

### Asset Path Examples
- Images: `/assets/img/filename.jpg`
- Videos: `/assets/video/filename.mp4`
- PDFs: `/assets/pdf/filename.pdf`

## Styling

The layout includes built-in responsive CSS styling that mimics the original Academic Project Page Template. You can:

1. Use the `_styles` front matter variable for page-specific styles
2. Override styles in your main CSS files
3. Include external CSS frameworks like Bulma

## Features

### Responsive Design
- Mobile-friendly layout
- Responsive video embeds
- Adaptive button sizing

### Accessibility
- Proper alt text support for images
- Semantic HTML structure
- Keyboard navigation support

### SEO Friendly
- Proper meta tags (inherited from Jekyll)
- Structured content sections
- Clean URLs

## Example

See `example_paper_project.md` for a complete example of how to use all available features.

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

1. **Videos not loading**: Ensure video files are in the correct path and format (MP4 recommended)
2. **Carousel not working**: Make sure `include_carousel_js: true` is set in front matter
3. **Styling issues**: Verify that `include_bulma_css: true` is set for Bulma styles

### Browser Compatibility
- Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile)
- Internet Explorer 11+ (limited support)

## Customization

You can customize the layout by:

1. Modifying the CSS in the `<style>` section of the layout file
2. Overriding specific sections by editing the HTML structure
3. Adding new front matter variables and corresponding Liquid template code

Given a goal briefly described in natural language, e.g., "make a shelf", and a video of the user's progress so far, the aim of VPA is to obtain a plan, i.e., a sequence of actions such as "sand shelf", "paint shelf", etc. to achieve the goal.
